name: Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce
author: netart.com

sections.description:
Building an engaged community of customers is the key to the success of any online store. Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce is a tool for WooCommerce that will allow you to realize the full potential of email marketing and effectively increase sales.

Earn more with effective email communication!

With Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce, you can easily export customer data and assign them to the appropriate recipient groups in the Mailer Panel of your Email Marketing service.

Fall in love with email marketing and increase your sales!

Mailer Panel, available as part of the Email Marketing service at netart.com, is a powerful easy-to-use tool that makes it easy to create and manage mailing campaigns.
 

With Mailer Panel, you can:

  • Create visually appealing emails with a simple drag & drop editor
  • Group your customers and tailor the content of your mailings to their preferences
  • Automate the sending of messages
  • Monitor campaign effectiveness and optimize actions based on statistics

Get started today and make email marketing work for your business success!
 

What do you gain with Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce plugin?

  • Easily export customer data – quickly download email addresses and other information needed for effective marketing.
  • Assign individual parameters to customers in groups – specify up to 10 options for each email address to personalize communications and increase conversions.
  • Seamless integration with Mailer Panel – import the database into Mailer Panel and start sending emails, using Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce you are sure that the exported data will be imported into Mailer Panel without errors.
  • More effective mailing campaigns – reach the right customers at the right time, increasing loyalty and sales.
     

Important information

  • File format – exported files are fully compatible with the format accepted by Mailer Panel, making the import process seamless.
  • Data security – the plug-in does not store or share any personal data with third parties.
  • Compatibility – works with the latest version of WooCommerce and WordPress, ensuring stability and high performance.

Do not lose valuable contacts – turn them into loyal customers! Download Mailer Panel – mail Marketing for WooCommerce and start growing your business effectively.
sections.installation: Upload the Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce plugin to your WordPress and activate it.
sections.faq:
1. What customer data can I export?

In addition to email addresses, which are the identifiers of each contact in Mailer Panel, you can export any of your customers data, among them name, company name, address or phone number. When exporting the data, you can select any 10 options, which you can change. Impotting the list of contacts into Mailer Panel in each group of recipients, you can have different options assigned to a given e-mail address.

2. Does the plugin store customer data?

No, the Mailer Panel – Email Marketing for WooCommerce plugin does not store any customer data after it is exported. The data is made available for download and is not stored on your hosting.

3. What file formats are supported?

The exported files are in CSV format, which allows you to seamlessly import your WooCommerce customer data into Mailer Panel.
